#  __MorrowCraft Update • v5.2__ 
We have added some new changes to the server. Check them out!
## [✚] Added Bedrock Updates
- You can now hold your shield by using your place button.
- You can now do **/online** to view all current online players. (works for java as well)

More Bedrock updates are coming soon! Just let me know if you run into any problems with Bedrock, and I'll get them fixed.

### Thank you for playing MorrowCraft! Report any bugs or issues in #channel. Also any suggestions, please send them in #channel.

#  __MorrowCraft Update • v5.0__ 
We have added some new changes to the server. Check them out!
## [✚] Added Mail System
- Doing **/mail <user> send** whilst holding a written book will send mail to the user's plot. 
- In the **/plot menu** you there is a mailbox.
-# Will be adding a mail send to all command sometime soon
## [✚] Added Plot Settings
- You can now change what settings are allowed in your plot.
- You can change visitors and plot members settings via the **/plot menu**.
## [✚] Added Plot Ban
- You can ban or unabn players from your plot with **/plot ban/unban <user>**.
- View banned players with **/plot banlist**
## [✚] Added /chestshop top
- You can now see the best selling chestshops.
- Click on them to locate.
## [✚] Added /chestshop locate
- Locate any item that is currently being sold by a player.
- Once you press the item and get a compass it will track the chestshop.
- Views price, location, stock, seller.
## [✚] Added Sales History
- In the chestshop menu you can view all sales.
## [✚] Added Shop Access
- Change permission for plot members for a specific chestshop.
- 3 Categories. Stock, Manage, Earnings. Each with their own permissions.
## [✚] Added /chestshop notify
- Toggle to receive sale notifications.
## [⟳] Updated Enderpearl Cooldown
- Changes: Cooldown from 15s → 30s.
## [⚙︎] Fixed Floating Item Bug
- Items above chestshops wont freeze and bug out after a restart. 
-# If you see one still bugged, open a ticket.

### Thank you for playing MorrowCraft! Report any bugs or issues in #channel. Also any suggestions, please send them in #channel.

@role 
#  __MorrowCraft Update • v4.0__ 
We have added some new changes to the server. Check them out!
## [✚] Added Fire Aspect 2
- Since the nether is released and pots are more common, you can now get fire aspect.
## [⟳] Updated Elos/Tiers
- I have done a massive update to elo gains and rules. Below is all the information:
   - Fair Kills: To trigger full Elo gains (+50 Base) and Rose rewards, you must kill a player wearing Protection 4 Diamond or Netherite armor.
   - Partial Gear+: Kills on players wearing Diamond or Netherite armor with Protection 3 or below will give reduced Elo (+16 to +25 Elo) and 0 Roses.
   - Gear Snapshot System: If a victim takes off their armor mid fight, the system remembers their highest gear tier for 10 seconds after being hit.
   - Team Kills: Teammate protection extends for 30 minutes after leaving a team so killing recent ex-teammates awards 0 Elo/Roses.
   - New Player Grace Period: Killing brand new players within their first 60 minutes on the server doesn't give any rewards.
- Also the elo gain depends on your current tier, so higher tier players will receive a lesser percentage than someone lower tiered.
## [⬇︎] Nerfed Implants 
- Changes: Chance from 20% → 5%. 
## [⬇︎] Nerfed Piercing
- Changes: INCREASE_DAMAGE from 50-100 → 20-30. (Might be nerfed more)
## [⚙︎] Fixed Attribute Swapping
- You can now attribute swap with the lunge spear.
## [⚙︎] Fixed Diamonds
- There was a bug where the placeholder %zdiamonds_balance% will show instead of the actual value.
- If you see this still, just make a ticket!
## [⚙︎] Fixed Maces
- Maces now follow vanilla rules where you must be 1.5 blocks in the air for it to do damage.
- Maces are still 4 hearts and the OP Mace 7 hearts.
## [⚙︎] Fixed Destruction 5
- It no longer gets rid of your opponents strength.

### Thank you for playing MorrowCraft! Report any bugs or issues in #channel. Also any suggestions, please send them in #channel.
